title: GTA6 Eve: Phantom Blade Zero Wins Push Square's October 2026 Poll
description: As the industry counts down to GTA6, Push Square reveals its October Game of the Month poll results following a busy month of PS5 releases.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Calm Before the GTA6 Storm: October's Gaming Landscape

For gaming enthusiasts worldwide, October is increasingly recognized by a very specific moniker: the month before GTA6.

As reported by gaming media outlet Push Square, those dramatic 31 days proved to be an incredibly busy period for new PS5 releases, immediately following an equally manic September. This unique positioning made the latest 'Game of the Month' player poll all the more intriguing for the gaming community.

## A Packed Schedule for PS5

With the monumental shadow of GTA6 looming large over the industry's horizon, developers and publishers have continued to push out notable titles for current-gen hardware. The back-to-back onslaught of releases across September and October created a hyper-competitive environment for PlayStation 5 owners.

While the exact results and voting margins highlight the diverse tastes of the player base, the broader context remains clear: players have been busier than ever navigating a massive influx of software as they eagerly count down the days toward Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster.

## Industry Context

Analyses of the current gaming market suggest that publishers are strategically navigating around the impending launch window of GTA6. Capturing player engagement and media attention during such a saturated period is no small feat, making every successful October release a notable achievement in its own right.

## Editor's Take

Push Square's October poll captures a fascinating transitional moment in gaming. As we stand firmly on the precipice of the GTA6 era, looking back at these dense release schedules reminds us just how vibrant the PS5 library remains even amidst a blockbuster-dominated horizon.
